function.name: list_customers

email.description: Exact email to match. Format: email address.

function.description: Get one customer.
function.name: get_customer

customer_id.description: ID of the customer, e.g. 'cus_4d2a9e71b3'. Find it with list_customers.

function.description: Create a customer.
function.name: create_customer

email.description: Email. Format: email address.

function.description: Charge a customer's card on file.
function.name: create_charge

amount.description: Amount. Format: amount in dollars, up to 2 decimals.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer, e.g. 'cus_4d2a9e71b3'. Find it with list_customers.

function.description: List a customer's charges.
function.name: list_charges

customer_id.description: ID of the customer, e.g. 'cus_4d2a9e71b3'. Find it with list_customers.

function.description: Refund a charge, fully or partially.
function.name: refund_charge

amount.description: Amount to refund; defaults to the full remaining amount. Format: amount in dollars, up to 2 decimals.

charge_id.description: ID of the charge, e.g. 'ch_7e3b1a90c4'. Find it with list_charges.

function.description: Create an invoice for a customer.
function.name: create_invoice

amount.description: Amount. Format: amount in dollars, up to 2 decimals.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer, e.g. 'cus_4d2a9e71b3'. Find it with list_customers.

function.description: List a customer's invoices.
function.name: list_invoices

customer_id.description: ID of the customer, e.g. 'cus_4d2a9e71b3'. Find it with list_customers.

function.description: Void an open invoice.
function.name: void_invoice

invoice_id.description: ID of the invoice, e.g. 'in_2c8f5d1a6e'. Find it with list_invoices.

function.description: Get the current documentation for an API endpoint: parameters, formats and return shape. Call with no arguments to list all endpoints.
function.name: get_api_docs
